Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal.vanilla

Class BlockLayout

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.internal.vanilla.BlockLayout
public final class BlockLayout extends Object
How the states of one block type are laid out in a palette: its properties (sorted by name), the values of each in order of first appearance, and how a combination of value indices maps to a state's position.

A combination is the mixed radix number sum(index(p) * radix(p)) with the first property varying fastest. Bedrock enumerates the states of every block as the full cartesian product of its values, in some property order, so the offset of a state from the first state of its block is sum(index(p) * stride(p)) (strides()). Blocks for which that does not hold (not a full product, or not in a stride order) get a lookup table instead (problem() says why).

Shared by the runtime (org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla) and :codegen:generateConstants, which verifies the bundled data and reports blocks needing a table. Not API.
